paper.title: A rugged yet easily navigable fitness landscape
paper.supplied_bibliography_errors: The supplied corpus entry lists Andrei Papkou, Aviv Regev, and Joanna Masel. Crossref's DOI record lists Andrei Papkou, Lucia Garcia-Pastor, José Antonio Escudero, and Andreas Wagner.

sources.what: Crossref DOI metadata used to verify title and author list.
Copy of the pre-existing supplementary-materials text extraction. The publisher PDF route returned an HTML security page.

overlaps.locator: Supplementary Materials, Fig. S21H panel annotation, printed p. 41; target transcription supplied in the assignment
overlaps.definition_quote: (H), (I), (J), (K) present the goodness of fit for lasso regression models restricted up to specific epistatic orders.
overlaps.definition_divergence: The paper describes a Walsh-Hadamard extension for non-biallelic genotypes and a penalized LASSO fit with lambda selected by cross-validation. GraphFLA uses one-hot drop-first features and unregularized polynomial OLS. Whether the reported R-squared is evaluated in-sample or on held-out folds is NOT STATED IN PAPER. The assigned processed input also contains 16,332 Asp27/Glu27 genotypes rather than the stated N=16,353, so no GraphFLA value was computed.

input.preprocessing: Reused dossier-audited processed input with the recorded nucleotide relabeling; D/E codon subset checked after decoding.

overlaps.graphfla_call: NOT RUN; intended call would be A.higher_order_epistasis(landscape, order=1).
overlaps.reason: No R-squared calculation was made: the paper's regularized Walsh-Hadamard/LASSO model is not GraphFLA's in-sample one-hot OLS metric, and the specified processed input fails the required exact-subset count.

overlaps.locator: Supplementary Materials, Fig. S21E, printed p. 41
overlaps.definition_quote: (E) and (F) show the performance of a penalized lasso regression, in which epistatic coefficients up to a certain order were used as predictors.
overlaps.definition_divergence: The plotted order-by-order R-squared curve is based on the paper's penalized LASSO models; GraphFLA returns in-sample OLS R-squared values at fixed orders. Per-point panel E values were not digitized, as instructed.

input.preprocessing: Reused dossier-audited processed input; no GraphFLA run.

overlaps.graphfla_call: NOT RUN; panel E points are plot-only and are not reproduction targets.
overlaps.reason: The per-point curve values are plotted rather than printed individually; no point values were digitized. The model definition also differs from GraphFLA.

blockers.what: Exact Asp27/Glu27 subset in the specified processed input
blockers.why: The decoded D/E codon filter gives 16,332 genotypes in this processed input, while the paper specifies N=16,353. The dossier's full RAW CSV contains 16,353 for the same filter, but the explicitly assigned processed input is missing 21 of those sequences; it was not replaced or supplemented.
blockers.needed_for: Any GraphFLA R-squared calculation against Fig. S21H-K.

blockers.why: The publisher route returned HTTP 403 with an HTML security-verification page, not the PDF. The existing SI text extraction supports Methods and caption quotes, but does not contain embedded panel labels; target labels below are transcribed from the assignment.
blockers.needed_for: Independent image-level verification of the four printed panel annotations.

verdict_reason: Fig. S21H-K are candidate overlaps with GraphFLA higher_order_epistasis, but the paper fits penalized LASSO models in a Walsh-Hadamard basis while GraphFLA computes unregularized one-hot polynomial OLS R-squared; the paper's R-squared evaluation split is NOT STATED IN PAPER. In addition, the specified processed input does not contain the exact 16,353-row subset. No GraphFLA R-squared values were computed.
